# General Intelligence Company — Style Reference

> Frosted glass laid over a hand-painted Central Park afternoon. Soft storybook serif at 48px, a medium grotesk at 15px, linen canvas #fefffc, hairline grey edges, and a single cerulean ring around the glass button.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is a painted-storybook interface language. The page opens on a 1920×1793px hand-painted autumn Manhattan, then settles onto a Linen Canvas of #fefffc, with #ffffff Paper for cards and footer, #f9faf7 Fog Field for inputs, and #ffffffd9 Frosted Pane for glass laid over the painting. The interface's chromatic budget is one hue: cerulean #0081c0 and its lighter ring #41a1cf, which appear on exactly two elements. Every other saturated pixel belongs to illustration. Type carries hierarchy through size alone. PP Mondwest at weights 400 and 500 runs across 27, 40, 48 and 54px with tracking near −0.02em, while Af holds body and UI at weight 500 in 13, 15 and 18px, tracked −0.01em. The jump from 15px body to the 48px manifesto is 3.2×, far steeper than a Major Third ladder. Shapes are soft: 8px buttons, a 12px nav and 16px cards. Elevation is whisper-thin, and the heaviest shadow is 15% black. The page reads as a picture book with a product inside rather than a software dashboard with a mascot.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#fefffc` | `--color-linen-canvas` | The page ground behind the vision, manifesto and product sections, with 6 background uses — a barely-green white that stops the white areas from reading as a default browser page. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | Writing-card image wells, the footer and on-image text, with 5 fills and 22 text uses — the brightest step, reserved for content surfaces and for type set directly on the painting. |
| Frosted Pane | `#ffffffd9` | `--color-frosted-pane` | Glass panels on the nav capsule and cookie toast, 3 uses — 85% white plus blur lets the painting bleed through, so chrome never fully hides the illustration. |
| Fog Field | `#f9faf7` | `--color-fog-field` | Footer input fill and the line work inside the logo glyph, 3 uses — a secondary surface one shade off canvas that separates fields without needing a border. |
| Onyx Ink | `#1f1f29` | `--color-onyx-ink` | The filled "Get Cofounder" button in the nav — the only inverted surface on the page, a blue-black that stays dark without the harshness of pure #000000. |
| Charcoal Ink | `#2c2c2c` | `--color-charcoal-ink` | Manifesto headlines, the "come work with us" link and section h2s, with 22 text uses — the workhorse heading color, softened from black so the 48px serif stays quiet. |
| Graphite Nav | `#444141` | `--color-graphite-nav` | Footer links, "Read more articles" and input text, 10 uses — a warm grey that carries UI labels one step below the headlines. |
| Pewter Caption | `#646464` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Vision paragraphs beside the pixel flower and supporting body copy, 6 uses — mid-grey that keeps long text recessive against the serif statements. |
| Mist Label | `#9db0bd` | `--color-mist-label` | Text inside the floating agent chips, 4 uses — a blue-grey that ties the chips to their tinted fill. Do not use it for body copy, because it fails contrast on Linen Canvas. |
| Stone Border | `#cfd1d3` | `--color-stone-border` | 1px hairlines on cards, mockup frames and dividers, 4 uses — the default edge, light enough that a border reads as a seam rather than a box. |
| Steel Chip | `#9cb4c024` | `--color-steel-chip` | Translucent fill on the agent tags (Customer Support, Sales, Marketing), 4 uses — a 14% blue-grey wash that makes tags float over serif text without adding a new hue. |
| Signal Cerulean | `#0081c0` | `--color-signal-cerulean` | Link tone and a single background fill — the one saturated hue the interface owns. Do not promote it to a full button fill or a section background. |
| Lagoon Ring | `#41a1cf` | `--color-lagoon-ring` | The 1px border on the glass "Get Cofounder" button over the painting — cerulean rendered as an outline, so the accent is a ring of light rather than a slab. |

## Tokens — Typography

### PP Mondwest — the storybook display voice for every statement, from wordmark to manifesto · `--font-pp-mondwest`

- **Substitute:** Newsreader Display at 450, Fraunces at 400 (opsz 72, SOFT 50), Libre Caslon Display at 400. Mondwest renders lighter than its nominal 500 and reads like a book-weight 400, so match that softer stroke and avoid any substitute at 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 27px, 40px, 48px, 54px
- **Line height:** 1.1 (40, 48 and 54px), 1.5 (27px)
- **Letter spacing:** −1.08px at 27px, −0.8px at 40px, −0.96px at 48px, −1.08px at 54px
- **OpenType features:** `"liga" 0`
- **Role:** A soft literary display face at weights 400 and 500 is the signature. Headlines are enormous but quiet, the opposite of the 700-weight grotesk most AI labs shout with. The 40→48 step is exactly 1.2, a Minor Third, and 48→54 tightens to 1.125, so the large sizes cluster as variations of one voice rather than a strict hierarchy. Ligatures are switched off (`"liga" 0`) so letter pairs stay discrete and typewritten. The 27px wordmark gets −0.04em tracking and a loose 1.5 leading, which makes it read as an engraved masthead.

### Af — the medium-weight grotesk for all body, UI and navigation · `--font-af`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 450 (variable), Geist at 500, Instrument Sans at 500. Af at 500 draws slightly lighter than Inter 500, so step Inter down to 450 to match the screenshots.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 13px, 15px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** −0.13px at 13px, −0.15px at 15px, −0.18px at 18px, normal at 16px (inherited anchor default)
- **OpenType features:** none detected
- **Role:** Weight 500 is the default for 47 of 50 Af elements. Body text is set one notch heavier than the convention of 400, which gives small grey copy enough ink to hold against the delicate serif. Tracking is a uniform −0.01em at every size, a single mechanical rule rather than optical tuning. The 15→18 step is 1.2, matching the serif's Minor Third. The pairing — book serif for ideas, compact grotesk for instructions — separates manifesto from interface at a glance.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| caption | Af | 500 | 13px | 1.4 | -0.13px | `--text-caption` |
| body | Af | 500 | 15px | 1.4 | -0.15px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | Af | 500 | 18px | 1.3 | -0.18px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | PP Mondwest | 400 | 27px | 1.5 | -1.08px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | PP Mondwest | 500 | 40px | 1.1 | -0.8px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | PP Mondwest | 500 | 48px | 1.1 | -0.96px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | PP Mondwest | 400 | 54px | 1.1 | -1.08px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Keep every saturated color inside illustration — UI chroma is limited to #0081c0 and #41a1cf on two elements, so the painting stays the loudest object on the page.
- Set statements in PP Mondwest at weight 500 and 48px with −0.96px tracking — size, not weight, carries authority, and the headline stays soft.
- Hold body and UI type at Af weight 500, 15px, line height 1.4, tracked −0.15px — one weight and one tracking rule make the interface read as a single instrument.
- Float chrome on #ffffffd9 glass with backdrop blur over imagery — the nav, toast and hero card borrow color from the painting instead of adding their own.
- Separate major sections with 120px of Linen Canvas #fefffc — the empty space is the pacing device that turns scrolling into page-turning.
- Use Onyx Ink #1f1f29 at an 8px radius for the single filled CTA per viewport — the dark slab is non-negotiable as the only inverted surface, which keeps action unambiguous.
- Keep shadows at or below 15% black, defaulting to `0px 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` — elevation should register as a breath, not a lift.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary button with #0081c0 — a blue slab would compete with the cerulean sky in the painting and break the zero-chroma interface rule.
- Don't bold the serif to 700 for hierarchy — PP Mondwest is used only at weights 400 and 500, and a heavy display weight turns the storybook voice into a pitch deck.
- Don't place headings in pure #000000 — Charcoal Ink #2c2c2c is the darkest heading tone, and black at 48px punches holes in the linen canvas.
- Don't drop body text to weight 400 at 13px in #646464 — the small grey copy loses its ink against the delicate serif, which is why Af defaults to 500.
- Don't wrap Writing Cards in a 1px #cfd1d3 bordered box with 24px padding — the cards are defined by image and headline alone, and a container makes them a SaaS feature grid.
- Don't round inputs to 8px or images to 16px — inputs and images sit at 0px, and softening them blurs the distinction between frames and the paper they are cut into.
- Don't add a gradient orb or glow behind the hero — the hand-painted scene is the only atmosphere the system permits, and a synthetic glow should never compete with it.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fefffc (Linen Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- glass surface: #ffffffd9 (Frosted Pane)
- heading text: #2c2c2c (Charcoal Ink)
- body text: #646464 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #cfd1d3 (Stone Border)
- accent ring: #41a1cf (Lagoon Ring)
- primary action: #1f1f29 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in neutrals — #2c2c2c for the primary series, #646464 for the secondary and #9cb4c024 Steel Chip for background bands — and at most one highlighted datum takes solid #0081c0, so the accent marks a single point rather than becoming the loudest fill on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a hero section: a full-bleed 1920px-wide hand-painted landscape image with a 0px radius, no border and no shadow. Center an h1 at the top in PP Mondwest (fallback Newsreader Display 450) at 27px, weight 400, line height 1.5, letter-spacing −1.08px, color #ffffff, with 40px top padding, in a 337px-wide column. Anchor a glass card bottom-left, 340px wide: background #ffffffd9 with backdrop-filter blur, border 1px solid #ffffff3d, radius 16px, padding 24px. Inside, place an h2 in PP Mondwest 40px weight 500, line height 1.1, letter-spacing −0.8px, color #ffffff. Follow it with a paragraph in Af (fallback Inter 450) 15px weight 500, line height 1.4, letter-spacing −0.15px, color #ffffff, 16px below the h2, then an underlined text link with a circular arrow chip at radius 9999px, 16px below the paragraph.

2. Build a Primary Action Button: background #1f1f29, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #282834, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px 8px 16px, height 36px, font Af 15px weight 500, line height 1.4, letter-spacing −0.15px, no shadow. Add a trailing 16px circular arrow icon at radius 9999px with an 8px gap from the label. On hover, keep the fill and let the arrow shift 4px to the right — color does not change.

3. Build a navigation bar: a fixed, horizontally centered capsule 54px tall, background #ffffffd9 with backdrop blur, border-radius 12px, padding 8px, box-shadow 0px 1px 8px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Left: a 34px logo tile. Middle: links About, Writing and Careers in Af 15px weight 500, letter-spacing −0.15px, color #ffffff over imagery or #444141 over #fefffc, with a 24px gap between links. Right: the Primary Action Button from prompt 2.

4. Build a Writing card grid: three columns with a 32px gap inside a 1280px max-width container on #fefffc. Each card is a 400×350px image on a #ffffff well with a 0px radius and box-shadow 0px 1px 1px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), followed 16px below by a title in Af 18px weight 500, line height 1.3, letter-spacing −0.18px, color #2c2c2c, max-width 272px. No card border, no card background and no padding. Below the grid, add a "Read more articles" text link in Af 15px weight 500, color #444141, 4px focus radius, 48px below the grid.

5. Build a manifesto block: a 700px-wide paragraph in PP Mondwest 48px weight 500, line height 1.1, letter-spacing −0.96px, color #2c2c2c, font-feature-settings "liga" 0, with 16px bottom padding, on #fefffc with 120px vertical section spacing. Overlay small floating chips on one phrase: background #9cb4c024, text #9db0bd in Af 13px weight 500, border-radius 27px, padding 4px 8px, box-shadow 0px 2px 4px 0px rgba(80,115,138,0.24).

**Role:** Fixed glass navigation over the painting

### Pill Button — Dark (Primary)

**Role:** The single filled call-to-action

### Glass Button — Cerulean Ring (Secondary)

**Role:** Accent action over imagery

It is set in Af 15px at weight 500, with backdrop blur at 9px and --shadow-md. This is the system outlier — the only place the cerulean hue becomes structural. It is allowed because it sits on the painting, where an outline is the one form of color that does not compete with the leaves.

### Arrow Text Link

**Role:** Tertiary navigation inside prose

An underlined phrase with a chip. It has no background, no padding and a 4px radius for the focus area. Text is Af 15px at weight 500 in #ffffff on imagery ("Get to know us"), #444141 Graphite Nav on canvas ("Read more articles") or #2c2c2c Charcoal Ink ("come work with us"), followed by a circular arrow glyph at 9999px radius. Use it wherever a button would interrupt reading — the link behaves like a footnote, not a banner.

### Hero Glass Card

**Role:** Mission statement over the painting

A frosted window onto foliage. It is anchored bottom-left, about 340px wide, with a 16px radius, 24px padding (estimated), heavy backdrop blur and a 1px border in #ffffff3d (glass-internal, not a system token). The headline is PP Mondwest 40px at weight 500 in #ffffff, line height 1.1, tracked −0.8px. Body copy is Af 15px at weight 500, line height 1.4, in #ffffff, followed by an Arrow Text Link. The blur turns the painting behind it into a warm bokeh, so the card borrows its color instead of declaring one.

### Painted Hero Wordmark

**Role:** Masthead set into the sky

Type as signage. The h1 is PP Mondwest 27px at weight 400 in #ffffff, line height 1.5, tracked −1.08px, with 40px top padding. It is centered in a 337px column, so "The General Intelligence Company Of New York" breaks onto two lines like an engraved plaque. At 27px it is deliberately smaller than every other serif on the page — the painting is the headline, and the wordmark is its caption.

### Striped Band Divider

**Role:** Transition from painting to canvas

A horizontal rule made of stripes. Stacked 1px-scale bands in #334444, #576a6a, #728383, #a5afaf and #cfd3cf (all decorative, not system tokens) step from dark slate to pale grey. The band spans the full 1920px width directly beneath the hero image. It replaces a gradient fade with something closer to a scanline or a picture-frame moulding, marking the shift from illustration to document.

### Vision Block with Pixel Illustration

**Role:** Two-column narrative beat

Pixel art beside prose. A pixelated yellow flower (decorative illustration) sits left on Linen Canvas #fefffc. The right column holds paragraphs in Af 15px at weight 500, line height 1.4, in Pewter Caption #646464, constrained to about 360px, with a 24px gap between paragraphs. It closes with a PP Mondwest 48px line in #2c2c2c. The pixel motif rhymes with Mondwest's bitmap lineage, so illustration and type are cut from the same nostalgia.

### Manifesto Statement with Agent Chips

**Role:** The argument, in large serif

Oversized literary prose. It is set in PP Mondwest 48px at weight 500, line height 1.1, tracked −0.96px, in Charcoal Ink #2c2c2c, about 700px wide with 16px bottom padding. Floating Agent Tag Chips hover over a struck-through phrase. Each chip is a Steel Chip #9cb4c024 fill with Mist Label #9db0bd text in Af 13px at weight 500, a 27px radius and --shadow-sm. Paragraph text set at 48px is anti-convention — the site argues rather than lists features.

### Writing Card

**Role:** The main content card

An editorial tile. The image well is Paper #ffffff at 400×350px with a 0px radius. The title is Af 18px at weight 500, line height 1.3, tracked −0.18px, in #292929 (renders as Charcoal Ink, not a separate token), wrapped at 272px. There is no border, an 8px gap and --shadow-subtle on the image frame. Cards run three across. The absence of a container means the card is defined by its image and headline alone — a magazine index, not a SaaS tile.

### Cookie Consent Toast

**Role:** Consent prompt floating mid-hero

A whispered request. It uses a Frosted Pane #ffffffd9 fill, an 8px radius, 8px 16px padding (estimated) and --shadow-sm-2. Copy is Af 13px at weight 500 in Graphite Nav #444141, with Decline and Accept as slash-separated text links rather than buttons. Consent is rendered as a sentence ("so things grow and flow just right"), so even compliance chrome keeps the storybook voice.

### Footer with Signup Field

**Role:** Closing statement and links

A white closing slab. It has a Paper #ffffff background and a 468px height, with links in Af 13px at weight 500 in #444141 at 4px radius. The signup input is Fog Field #f9faf7 with text in Af 13px at weight 500, #444141, line height 1.5, a 0px radius, no border and a 24px height. The square input is the deliberate shape outlier inside a soft system — it sits flush within a rounded container, so the field reads as a slot cut into paper.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Keep every saturated color inside illustration — UI chroma is limited to #0081c0 and #41a1cf on two elements, so the painting stays the loudest object on the page.
- Set statements in PP Mondwest at weight 500 and 48px with −0.96px tracking — size, not weight, carries authority, and the headline stays soft.
- Hold body and UI type at Af weight 500, 15px, line height 1.4, tracked −0.15px — one weight and one tracking rule make the interface read as a single instrument.
- Float chrome on #ffffffd9 glass with backdrop blur over imagery — the nav, toast and hero card borrow color from the painting instead of adding their own.
- Separate major sections with 120px of Linen Canvas #fefffc — the empty space is the pacing device that turns scrolling into page-turning.
- Use Onyx Ink #1f1f29 at an 8px radius for the single filled CTA per viewport — the dark slab is non-negotiable as the only inverted surface, which keeps action unambiguous.
- Keep shadows at or below 15% black, defaulting to `0px 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` — elevation should register as a breath, not a lift.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary button with #0081c0 — a blue slab would compete with the cerulean sky in the painting and break the zero-chroma interface rule.
- Don't bold the serif to 700 for hierarchy — PP Mondwest is used only at weights 400 and 500, and a heavy display weight turns the storybook voice into a pitch deck.
- Don't place headings in pure #000000 — Charcoal Ink #2c2c2c is the darkest heading tone, and black at 48px punches holes in the linen canvas.
- Don't drop body text to weight 400 at 13px in #646464 — the small grey copy loses its ink against the delicate serif, which is why Af defaults to 500.
- Don't wrap Writing Cards in a 1px #cfd1d3 bordered box with 24px padding — the cards are defined by image and headline alone, and a container makes them a SaaS feature grid.
- Don't round inputs to 8px or images to 16px — inputs and images sit at 0px, and softening them blurs the distinction between frames and the paper they are cut into.
- Don't add a gradient orb or glow behind the hero — the hand-painted scene is the only atmosphere the system permits, and a synthetic glow should never compete with it.

## Imagery

Imagery is illustration, never stock photography or glossy product renders. The hero is a full-bleed 1920×1793px digital painting of Central Park in autumn: Manhattan towers, a lake and two figures seated in a field of orange leaves. It is framed with a 0px radius, no border and no shadow, so the page itself becomes the canvas. Below the fold the register shifts to pixel art — a blocky yellow flower — echoing PP Mondwest's bitmap ancestry. Writing cards use 400×350px images on #ffffff wells at a 0px radius. Icons are minimal: circular arrow chips and a pixel-grid logo glyph. There are no gradient orbs or glows. The striped band is the only decorative device, and it is not a system token. The narrative is a humane future painted by hand, with AI tucked quietly inside it.

## Layout

Content centers within a 1080px max-width, widening to 1280px for card rows, while the hero and striped band run the full 1920px. Sections breathe on 120px gaps, and the largest measured spacer is 220px. The hero is a single painting with a centered wordmark at the top, a glass mission card bottom-left and a small caption bottom-right. Below it, sections alternate between two-column beats (pixel flower left, prose right), single-column manifesto statements about 700px wide, a framed product mockup, an image-backed Cofounder statement at 54px, and a three-column Writing grid. The nav is a fixed, centered glass capsule 54px tall: logo left, three links in the middle, the Onyx CTA right. The footer is a 468px white slab. At 375px, set the display role to 40px and section gaps to 64px. Density is spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fefffc (Linen Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- glass surface: #ffffffd9 (Frosted Pane)
- heading text: #2c2c2c (Charcoal Ink)
- body text: #646464 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #cfd1d3 (Stone Border)
- accent ring: #41a1cf (Lagoon Ring)
- primary action: #1f1f29 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in neutrals — #2c2c2c for the primary series, #646464 for the secondary and #9cb4c024 Steel Chip for background bands — and at most one highlighted datum takes solid #0081c0, so the accent marks a single point rather than becoming the loudest fill on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a hero section: a full-bleed 1920px-wide hand-painted landscape image with a 0px radius, no border and no shadow. Center an h1 at the top in PP Mondwest (fallback Newsreader Display 450) at 27px, weight 400, line height 1.5, letter-spacing −1.08px, color #ffffff, with 40px top padding, in a 337px-wide column. Anchor a glass card bottom-left, 340px wide: background #ffffffd9 with backdrop-filter blur, border 1px solid #ffffff3d, radius 16px, padding 24px. Inside, place an h2 in PP Mondwest 40px weight 500, line height 1.1, letter-spacing −0.8px, color #ffffff. Follow it with a paragraph in Af (fallback Inter 450) 15px weight 500, line height 1.4, letter-spacing −0.15px, color #ffffff, 16px below the h2, then an underlined text link with a circular arrow chip at radius 9999px, 16px below the paragraph.

2. Build a Primary Action Button: background #1f1f29, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #282834, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px 8px 16px, height 36px, font Af 15px weight 500, line height 1.4, letter-spacing −0.15px, no shadow. Add a trailing 16px circular arrow icon at radius 9999px with an 8px gap from the label. On hover, keep the fill and let the arrow shift 4px to the right — color does not change.

3. Build a navigation bar: a fixed, horizontally centered capsule 54px tall, background #ffffffd9 with backdrop blur, border-radius 12px, padding 8px, box-shadow 0px 1px 8px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Left: a 34px logo tile. Middle: links About, Writing and Careers in Af 15px weight 500, letter-spacing −0.15px, color #ffffff over imagery or #444141 over #fefffc, with a 24px gap between links. Right: the Primary Action Button from prompt 2.

4. Build a Writing card grid: three columns with a 32px gap inside a 1280px max-width container on #fefffc. Each card is a 400×350px image on a #ffffff well with a 0px radius and box-shadow 0px 1px 1px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), followed 16px below by a title in Af 18px weight 500, line height 1.3, letter-spacing −0.18px, color #2c2c2c, max-width 272px. No card border, no card background and no padding. Below the grid, add a "Read more articles" text link in Af 15px weight 500, color #444141, 4px focus radius, 48px below the grid.

5. Build a manifesto block: a 700px-wide paragraph in PP Mondwest 48px weight 500, line height 1.1, letter-spacing −0.96px, color #2c2c2c, font-feature-settings "liga" 0, with 16px bottom padding, on #fefffc with 120px vertical section spacing. Overlay small floating chips on one phrase: background #9cb4c024, text #9db0bd in Af 13px weight 500, border-radius 27px, padding 4px 8px, box-shadow 0px 2px 4px 0px rgba(80,115,138,0.24).

## Painting-Led Chroma

The discipline is that the illustration owns every saturated hue and the interface owns almost none. Across 17 background colors, only #0081c0 and #41a1cf are chromatic UI values, with one use each, and the mint #a0d7d1 tones are decorative, not system tokens. This breaks the moment a designer introduces a colored section band, a blue CTA slab, colored icons or a gradient hero overlay — any of these competes with the orange canopy and cerulean sky of the painting. To extend the system, add new hues only inside new illustrations, keep fresh UI states in the #2c2c2c, #444141 and #646464 neutral ladder, and express emphasis through glass, size or a single 1px #41a1cf ring rather than through fills.

## Literary Display Restraint

The headline voice is a soft serif at weights 400 and 500 with tracking near −0.02em, and full sentences are set at 48px. That is a rejection of the convention of bold, short, sans-serif AI-lab slogans. The discipline breaks if anyone bolds Mondwest to 600 or 700, re-enables ligatures, tightens line height below 1.1, or swaps in a geometric grotesk for headlines — the page instantly becomes a pitch deck. To extend it, write new sections as prose statements rather than feature bullets. Stay inside the 27, 40, 48 and 54px steps, let Af at 15px and weight 500 carry anything procedural, and keep heading color at #2c2c2c so scale, not darkness, signals importance.

## Glass Over Paint

Chrome is a transparent layer resting on the painting, never a slab covering it. The nav capsule, hero card, toast and cerulean button all use #ffffffd9 or a transparent fill with backdrop blur, a radius between the 8px and 16px tokens, and shadows no heavier than 15% black. This breaks with opaque white bars, full-width nav strips, drop shadows above 0.15 alpha, or glass applied on the plain #fefffc canvas, where blur has nothing to refract. To extend it, reserve glass for components that sit over imagery. On canvas, switch to Paper #ffffff with a 1px #cfd1d3 hairline or the rgb(222, 226, 222) ring, so material always corresponds to what lies beneath it.

## Similar Brands

- **Anthropic** — Shares the warm off-white canvas and a book-like serif for statements in an AI-lab context, though Anthropic leans on terracotta accents where General Intelligence Company keeps UI chroma at near zero.
- **The Browser Company** — Shares the storybook, hand-illustrated hero and a whimsical narrative voice around a technical product, while General Intelligence Company replaces playful gradients with a single painting.
- **Notion** — Shares a near-monochrome interface that lets illustration supply all personality, though Notion uses ink line drawings where this site uses full-color painting and pixel art.
- **Lindy** — A category competitor in autonomous business agents; it shares the agent-coordination pitch but runs a conventional SaaS layout with colored CTAs that this site deliberately avoids.
- **Teenage Engineering** — Shares the restraint of small medium-weight UI type against generous emptiness, with General Intelligence Company swapping industrial minimalism for a painted pastoral.
